functions.name: ConvertHSLToHSV
documentation: Converts an unpacked HSL color to HSV.

functions.name: ConvertHSVToHSL
documentation: Converts an unpacked HSV color to HSL.

functions.name: ConvertHSVToRGB
documentation: Converts an unpacked HSV color to RGB.

functions.name: ConvertRGBToHSV
documentation: Converts an unpacked RGB color to HSV. For achromatic inputs, the returned hue will be -1.

functions.name: GenerateTextColorCode
documentation: Generates a hex color code suitable for use in text color code markup.

arguments.name: color
documentation: Color to generate a hex color code from.

returns.name: textColorCode
documentation: Hex representation of the color formatted as an 8-byte ARGB string, with alpha forced to 255.

functions.name: WrapTextInColor
documentation: Wraps a given string with color code markup.

arguments.name: text
documentation: Text to be wrapped in color markup.

arguments.name: color
documentation: Color to apply to the text.

returns.name: coloredText
documentation: The input text wrapped in '|c' and '|r' quoted code sequences for the supplied color.

functions.name: WrapTextInColorCode
documentation: Wraps a given string with color code markup.

arguments.name: text
documentation: Text to be wrapped in color markup.

arguments.name: textColorCode
documentation: Color to apply to the text, formatted as an 8-byte ARGB string as returned by GenerateTextColorCode.

returns.name: coloredText
documentation: The input text wrapped in '|c' and '|r' quoted code sequences for the supplied color.
